allOf.$comment: Mirrors RunLogEntry._attribution_on_success (llmxive.types): a SUCCESS entry must name the backend and model that answered. Only an entry for a run that produced no response may leave them null.

run_id.description: UUID v4 of the parent scheduled workflow run.

entry_id.description: UUID v4 of this specific agent invocation.

parent_entry_id.description: If this is a sub-task spawned by Atomizer, the parent's entry_id.

backend.description: The backend that actually answered. null ONLY when no ChatResponse came back (a run that failed before or during the model call); see the allOf rule below.

model_name.description: The model that actually answered, or the deterministic-no-llm sentinel. null ONLY when no ChatResponse came back; see the allOf rule below.

cost_estimate_usd.description: Total settled cost of the run. MUST be 0 unless the cost was incurred on the funded huggingface backend (no opt-in needed) or an opt-in paid backend is active.

cost_by_backend.description: Optional breakdown of cost_estimate_usd by the backend that served each response; sums to cost_estimate_usd. Only the portion not served by huggingface is checked against the paid opt-in.
